summary: Implemented a plan-first, checksum-pinned migration runner with a MongoDB ledger, an adapter boundary for isolated backup/restore drills, and a non-destructive index rollout derived from the existing property schema and canonical index catalog. Migrations require explicit confirmation, unknown or changed ledger entries fail closed, backup execution reports blocked/failed states unless an injected provider verifies an isolated restore, and index rollout creates only validated missing indexes. The contracts barrel and test-suite registry were wired as necessary integration changes outside the database source/test roots.
